test_title: PYST 62: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Fictions are Nonfictions.

Some Nonfictions are Poetries.

All Poetries are Dramas.

**Conclusion (I):** Some Nonfictions are Dramas.

**Conclusion (II):** Some Fictions are Dramas.
solution:
**Given Statements:**

Some Fictions are Nonfictions.

Some Nonfictions are Poetries.

All Poetries are Dramas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c84bc6570c91137b0ba681aed104d6d139b815fb6fa1dd2b5d3d6ec69c4bc8d.png] 

**Checking Conclusions:**

**(I) Some Nonfictions are Dramas**: **Follows** (because,Some Nonfictions are Poetries, and all Poetries are Dramas.So, some Nonfictions are definitely) Dramas.

**(II) Some Fictions are Dramas**: **Does not Follows **(because, Some Fictions are Nonfictions.Some Nonfictions are Poetries → Dramas.But it is not definite that the same Nonfictions connected to Fictions are also connected to Dramas.)

Hence, **only conclusion (I) follows.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
